fields.overview_heading: Foggy glass? The seal has failed
fields.overview_body:
Fog or condensation between the panes is a sign the seal has gone. SolidGuard does double-pane window repair across Toronto and the GTA: we replace the failed sealed unit and slot it into your existing frame, so the window looks and performs like new. Foggy window repair is usually same or next day, at a fraction of the cost of a new window.

You do not need to replace foggy windows wholesale. In most cases a sealed unit replacement clears the fog for good, restores the insulating gas, and stops the draft. We assess the frame, confirm the unit size, and handle the swap clean.
fields.repairfirst_body: Replacing the whole window to fix foggy windows is almost never necessary. If the frame is sound, the sealed unit is what gets replaced, and that is the repair we recommend.
fields.whatwehandle_heading: Foggy and sealed-unit problems we fix

faqs.question: Why is my double-pane window foggy?
faqs.answer: The seal around the glass unit has failed, letting moisture in between the panes. The fog is trapped condensation, and it will not wipe off.

faqs.question: Can a foggy window be repaired, or do I replace it?
faqs.answer: You replace the sealed glass unit, not the whole window. We slot a new unit into your existing frame, which is far cheaper than a new window.

faqs.question: Will the fog come back?
faqs.answer: Not with a new sealed unit. A proper double-pane window repair restores the seal and the insulating gas for years.

faqs.question: How fast can you come out?
faqs.answer: Same or next day across most of the GTA.
